name: Sandy River Apples/Fenton's Orchard
tagline: Sandy River Apples in Mercer, Maine
description: In Sandy River Road, ME, Sandy River Apples/Fenton's Orchard raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a working farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer, autumn, and spring. Check the website for current hours and availability.
